extracted.intended_audience: lessees, grant holders, project engineers, Certified Verification Agents (CVAs), and other stakeholders involved in BOEM-regulated offshore renewable energy projects
extracted.subtask_description: Extracted standards and requirements from BOEM's proposed revisions to 30 CFR Part 585 covering GAP/SAP/COP/GAP submissions, facility design/fabrication/installation reports, CVA duties, Safety Management Systems, inspections/self-inspections, recordkeeping, and decommissioning for offshore renewable energy projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decommissioning application timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Lessees would initiate the decommissioning process by submitting a decommissioning application as much as 2 years before the lease expires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed revision to §585.638 for clarity and consistency with §§585.905 and 585.906; reflects new subpart J expectations versus prior language that required initiating decommissioning upon completion of approved COP activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: General Activities Plan (GAP) submission due date and redundancy removal
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminate the second sentence in paragraph (b) of §585.640 because it is redundant with existing and proposed §585.303(a) regarding the due date for GAP submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative/organizational change to avoid duplicative text; ensures consistency across rules about GAP due dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: GAP content consistency with SAP/COP changes
rubrics_metrics.description: GAPs must demonstrate and include content consistent with proposed revisions to §§585.606, 585.621, 585.610 (SAPs) and 585.626 (COPs) as appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical edits proposed in §585.641 and §585.645 to align GAP informational requirements with analogous SAP and COP requirements; ensures harmonized expectations across plan types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic-only submission requirement (no paper copy)
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminate the paper copy requirement for submitting GAPs, FDRs, FIRs, CVA reports, and related materials (consistent with proposed §585.110).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed across multiple sections (e.g., §§585.642, 585.701, 585.702, 585.712) to modernize submissions and remove the redundant table column referring to paper copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: GAP informational and certification requirements to assist NEPA and other laws
rubrics_metrics.description: GAPs must include information and certifications to assist BOEM in complying with NEPA and other applicable laws; uses phrase 'applicable laws' instead of 'relevant laws'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifications in §585.646 mirror those proposed for SAPs (§585.611) and COPs (§585.627); BOEM notes these clarifications match current expectations and should not create additional burdens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal consistency processing for GAPs under CZMA
rubrics_metrics.description: BOEM will process GAPs for Federal consistency under the Coastal Zone Management Act with minor changes to provide clarity and consistency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See proposed §585.647; changes are primarily clarifying and organizational.

rubrics_metrics.name: GAP activity duration aligned with limited lease periods
rubrics_metrics.description: Time allowed to conduct activities under an approved GAP is technically revised to be consistent with proposed limited lease periods in §585.236.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed change in §585.652; ensures GAP activity windows align with lease period modifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: GAP revision triggers and approval timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify what activities require a revision to a GAP and when BOEM will approve the revision, analogous to SAP and COP revision provisions (§585.617 and §585.634).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.655; technical clarifications to harmonize revision processes across plan types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Air quality requirements inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: SAPs, COPs, and GAPs must include requirements regarding air quality that reflect Congress' 2011 CAA amendment expanding BOEM's air quality jurisdiction to offshore of the North Slope Borough of Alaska.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical correction proposed in §585.659 to reflect statutory changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Staged submittal of Facility Design Report (FDR) and Fabrication and Installation Report (FIR)
rubrics_metrics.description: BOEM may allow lessees to submit FDRs and FIRs by stage or component; each component report would have its own 60-day review period once BOEM deems it submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.700 to provide flexibility so fabrication/construction of components can commence while other aspects remain under review, contingent on adequate explanation that components will function together per project design basis as verified by the project CVA.

rubrics_metrics.name: FDR/FIR submission timing relative to plan approval and start of review clock
rubrics_metrics.description: FDRs and FIRs may be submitted before or after SAP/COP/GAP approval, but BOEM's 60-day review period will not start until the report is deemed submitted and the corresponding plan is approved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed to ensure BOEM's review clock begins only when submission is complete, accurate, and ready for consideration; connected to proposed §585.704 completeness determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited early procurement/fabrication activities allowed
rubrics_metrics.description: Procurement of discrete parts that are commercially available in standardized form and type-certified components, or fabrication activities not occurring on the OCS, may commence prior to submittal of FDR/FIR or any BOEM-required plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed new §585.700(e)(i); however, such procurement/fabrication prior to BOEM non-objection or the end of the 60-day review is subject to CVA verification and possible BOEM objection before installation on the OCS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'fabrication'
rubrics_metrics.description: Define 'fabrication' as 'the cutting, fitting, welding, or other assembly of project elements of a custom design conforming to project-specific requirements,' excluding procurement of discrete commercially available standardized or type-certified components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed addition to §585.112 to clarify scope and differentiate fabrication from procurement of off-the-shelf components.

rubrics_metrics.name: BOEM 60-calendar-day objection/request period for FDR/FIR
rubrics_metrics.description: BOEM has 60 calendar days to object to an FDR or FIR or to request additional information, but additional time may be needed for review if key information is missing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed revision in §585.700 (redesignated paragraph f) to emphasize that review may require more time when submissions are incomplete.

rubrics_metrics.name: FDR content requirements (geotechnical, archaeological, design standards, critical safety systems)
rubrics_metrics.description: FDR must include results of any deferred detailed geotechnical surveys and archaeological surveys, design standards (allowing lessee-proposed project-specific standards), and information on critical safety systems including a risk assessment identifying and describing those systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed additions in §585.701(a)(12)-(13); CVA must verify facility designed to provide for safety; catch-all category proposed for project-specific necessary information; removal of paper column and trade secrets redundancy; substitution of 'verification' for 'certification' for CVA duties.

rubrics_metrics.name: FIR content requirements (QA certificates, environmental incorporation by reference, commissioning procedures)
rubrics_metrics.description: FIR must include any certificates documenting adherence to a recognized quality assurance standard; may incorporate environmental information from previously submitted plans by reference where it satisfies FIR requirements; must include commissioning procedures for critical safety systems (including OEM procedures).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.702 (new paragraphs a(6), a(7)(i)-(iv), a(8)); elimination of paper copy column and inclusion of catch-all category for project-specific info.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major modifications and repairs reporting and CVA verification
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminate term 'certified' for major repairs/modifications; require any major modification or repair report to contain a CVA verification statement. Redefine 'major repair' to include substantial repairs to critical safety systems and 'major modification' to include substantial alteration of a critical safety system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.703(a); ensures BOEM is informed of significant work on critical safety systems and that such work adheres to accepted engineering practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completeness determination before review clock
rubrics_metrics.description: BOEM will have 20 calendar days to determine whether an FDR, FIR, or project verification report is sufficiently accurate and complete; once deemed submitted the applicable 60- or 30-day review clock begins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.704 to address past issues with incomplete submissions and to clarify that BOEM's review period starts only after completeness determination; modeled on §550.231 practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow multiple CVAs and partial CVA waivers
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed rule explicitly allows multiple CVAs on a project and permits BOEM to grant partial waivers of the CVA requirement for discrete project elements; waived elements must still adhere to a recognized quality assurance standard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.705 and discussed in §585.706; permits assignment of CVAs by component while maintaining oversight and quality standards; CVA role remains unless waived under specified conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: CVA commissioning verification and incident reporting duties
rubrics_metrics.description: CVA must ensure critical safety systems are commissioned in accordance with procedures identified in FDR, FIR, and modification/repair reports, and must provide BOEM immediate reports of incidents affecting commissioning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed additions to §585.705 to meet §585.102(a)(1) obligations for safety; clarifies that the third-party verifying commissioning should be the CVA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timing and requirement for nominating CVAs
rubrics_metrics.description: Lessee or grant holder no longer required to nominate a CVA with COP, SAP, or GAP; must nominate and obtain approval for a CVA before conducting relevant verification activities. If multiple CVAs are used, nominate a general project CVA no later than COP submittal to manage verification strategy and transitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.706 to provide greater flexibility and allow earlier CVA engagement; general project CVA coordinates multiple CVAs and ensures integrated verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: CVA conflict-of-interest restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Nominated CVA must not have been involved in preparing the plans, reports, analyses, or other technical submittals that it will verify to avoid conflicts of interest or appearance thereof.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarification in §585.706; underscores objectivity requirement central to the CVA role.

rubrics_metrics.name: CVA duties for facility design review (verify safety and human-safety assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: CVA must 'verify' (not 'certify') and is required to verify that the facility has been designed to provide for safety and to conduct an independent assessment of the design for human safety and accident prevention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.707 to align with change in standard from 'certify' to 'verify' and to strengthen independent safety assessment responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: CVA/project engineer duties for fabrication and installation review
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace 'certify'/'ensure' with 'verify'; require use of good engineering judgment when assessing commissioning of critical safety systems; require monitoring of commissioning and provision of commissioning records and their locations; require final verification report for entire project by general project CVA prior to commencement of commercial operations if multiple CVAs used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.708 and related paragraphs; clarifies expectations for evidence and reporting of commissioning and for coordination among multiple CVAs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Onsite fabrication inspection verification items
rubrics_metrics.description: When conducting onsite fabrication inspections CVA or project engineer must verify structural integrity, stability, and ballast of floating facilities; certain foundation, piling, anchoring, and mooring items removed here because addressed elsewhere (§585.710).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed revision in §585.709 to mirror FDR changes and to focus verification on floating facility structural matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Onsite installation inspection verification and periodic inspections
rubrics_metrics.description: CVA must verify enumerated installation items and the commissioning of critical safety systems; new expectation for periodic on-site inspections to verify (1) systems and equipment function as designed and (2) final commissioning records are complete.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.710; paragraph (f) clarifies periodic inspection expectations to meet OCS Lands Act and §585.102(a)(1) safety obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: CVA reporting content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: CVA reports must summarize any issues with facility design, fabrication, or installation, or the commissioning of critical safety systems, to enable BOEM to catalog history of resolved issues and lessons learned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.712; eliminates paper copy requirement and codifies standard industry practice to improve BOEM oversight and industry learning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recordkeeping of commissioning of critical safety systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Records of commissioning of critical safety systems must be kept and made available to BOEM representatives until BOEM releases the lessee from its financial assurance; lessee must provide BOEM the location of these records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.714; clarifies that recordkeeping requirements apply to design, engineering, modification and repair reports in this subpart, and removes references duplicative of other sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: SMS requirement and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Lessee must use a Safety Management System (SMS) for activities conducted on the OCS to develop or operate a lease—from met buoy placement and site assessment through decommissioning—and must provide its SMS to BOEM upon request and submit a detailed description with COP/SAP/GAP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.810; SMS complexity must be proportionate to activities covered; SMS intended to increase risk awareness, communication, mitigation, and disciplined organizational approaches addressing personnel safety, remote monitoring, control/shutdown capabilities, emergency response, fire suppression, SMS testing, and personnel training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party SMS certification option
rubrics_metrics.description: Third-party SMS certification may be obtained from accredited safety and environmental CABs; such certification could reduce BOEM inspection frequency/scope and oversight of corrective actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed new §585.811; CAB certification using consensus standards (e.g., ANSI Z10 or ISO/IEC 45001) could be relied upon in lieu of some BOEM inspections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation and reporting for SMS (functionality and reporting cadence)
rubrics_metrics.description: SMS must remain functional while activities are performed; annual safety performance summary due March 31 covering the prior calendar year; triennial (every 3 years) summary of most recent SMS audit and corrective actions or upon BOEM request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed revisions in §585.812 remove 'fully' from 'fully functional', expand headings, and add two reporting requirements (annual safety performance form similar to BSEE's, and a 3-year SMS audit summary) to allow measurement of SMS success and industry comparisons.

rubrics_metrics.name: BOEM inspections authority and focus
rubrics_metrics.description: BOEM may conduct optional inspections (scheduled or unscheduled) of OCS facilities and vessels to verify activities comply with the OCS Lands Act, Part 585 regulations, lease/grant terms, approved plans, and other applicable laws and to determine whether proper safety equipment is installed and operating per the SMS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §§585.820–585.821; revisions clarify inspection flexibility and that BOEM's inspections verify compliance and safety equipment operation according to the SMS.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection access and record retention for BOEM review
rubrics_metrics.description: When BOEM conducts an inspection, the lessee must provide access to all facilities and vessels used for authorized activities and must retain records until BOEM releases the associated financial assurance and make those records available upon request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.822 and related recordkeeping sections to ensure documentation availability during inspections and prior to release of financial assurance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-inspection frequency and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Lessee must conduct onsite inspections of each of its facilities at least once a year; inspection must include, but is not limited to, all safety equipment designed to prevent or ameliorate fires, spillages, or other major accidents; lessee must maintain records, summarize results, and provide them to BOEM upon request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.824 to allow BOEM flexibility to rely on lessee self-inspection to meet annual onsite inspection requirements where BOEM does not inspect in a given year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incident reporting cross-reference correction
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct an erroneous cross-reference in §585.830(d) to point to the appropriate BSEE regulatory citation for reporting oil spills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical correction maintaining accurate regulatory cross-references for incident reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decommissioning jurisdictional exception for certain facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Add a limited exception in subpart J (§585.900(c)) for facilities approved by and subject to decommissioning requirements of another Federal authority (e.g., met buoys subject to USACE NWP 5), provided those other procedures are an adequate substitute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If USACE does not require removal, BOEM would retain enforcement authority; intended primarily for met buoys that may not require a SAP under proposed §585.600.

rubrics_metrics.name: BOEM authority to order earlier decommissioning
rubrics_metrics.description: BOEM may order decommissioning of facilities earlier than 2 years following lease termination if the facilities are no longer useful for operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed in §585.902 to allow BOEM to require earlier removal where appropriate.
